project: City of Manila Small Business Document Master Checklist

documents_to_fill_or_acquire.document_name: DTI Business Name Registration Application Form
documents_to_fill_or_acquire.where_to_get: DTI BNRS Portal (bnrs.dti.gov.ph) or DTI NCRO Office
documents_to_fill_or_acquire.output_received: DTI Certificate of Business Name Registration (CBNR)

documents_to_fill_or_acquire.where_to_get: DFA / LTO / PSA / PhilPost / SSS / GSIS
prerequisites: PhilID, Passport, Driver's License, or UMID

documents_to_fill_or_acquire.where_to_get: Barangay Hall desk of your specific Manila district
Lessor / Property Owner / Registry of Deeds
prerequisites: Notarized Lease Contract + Lessor's Tax Receipt (if renting)
Transfer Certificate of Title / Tax Declaration (if owned)

stages.agency: Manila City Planning (CPDO) / MHD / Bureau of Fire Protection

documents_to_fill_or_acquire.where_to_get: City Planning and Development Office (CPDO - Manila City Hall Annex)
documents_to_fill_or_acquire.filing_mode: In-Person / Integrated in GO! Manila Portal

prerequisites: Employee Medical Results (Chest X-Ray, Stool, Urine)
1x1 ID Photos for Employee Health Cards (Yellow Cards)

documents_to_fill_or_acquire.where_to_get: Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP) Manila Fire District Station
documents_to_fill_or_acquire.output_received: FSIC Order of Payment / Safety Clearance Certificate

stages.agency: Business Permits and Licensing Service (BPLS) - City of Manila

documents_to_fill_or_acquire.document_name: Application for New Mayor's Business Permit
documents_to_fill_or_acquire.estimated_fee: Free to apply; fees assessed based on initial capital

documents_to_fill_or_acquire.document_name: Unified Statement of Account Payment Receipt
documents_to_fill_or_acquire.where_to_get: GO! Manila Portal / Bayad Center / Over-the-Counter
Downloaded via GO! Manila History Tab / BPLS City Hall Counter
documents_to_fill_or_acquire.output_received: Official Mayor's Permit (Must frame and display)

stages.stage_name: BIR Tax Registration & Authority to Print
stages.agency: Bureau of Internal Revenue (Assigned Manila RDO 29 to 34)

documents_to_fill_or_acquire.document_name: BIR Form 1901 (Application for Sole Proprietor Registration)
documents_to_fill_or_acquire.where_to_get: BIR ORUS Portal (orus.bir.gov.ph) or RDO Counter
prerequisites: Mayor's Business Permit or Barangay Clearance
documents_to_fill_or_acquire.estimated_fee: ₱30 Loose Documentary Stamp Tax (ARF ₱500 now REPEALED)

documents_to_fill_or_acquire.document_name: BIR Form 1906 (Application for Authority to Print - ATP)
documents_to_fill_or_acquire.where_to_get: BIR RDO Counter / BIR Accredited Printing Press
prerequisites: Sample Invoice/Receipt Layout compliant with EOPT Act
documents_to_fill_or_acquire.estimated_fee: Included in printing press service charge

documents_to_fill_or_acquire.document_name: BIR Printed Invoices (BPI) or Accredited Sales Invoices
documents_to_fill_or_acquire.where_to_get: RDO New Business Registrant Counter or Accredited Printer

documents_to_fill_or_acquire.filing_mode: Physical Presentation at RDO for Official Stamping
prerequisites: 4 General Books: Cash Receipts Journal, Cash Disbursements Journal, General Journal, General Ledger
documents_to_fill_or_acquire.output_received: BIR Stamped Official Books of Accounts

documents_to_fill_or_acquire.document_name: BIR Certificate of Registration (COR - Form 2303) & Public Poster
documents_to_fill_or_acquire.where_to_get: Assigned Manila RDO / Downloaded from BIR ORUS
documents_to_fill_or_acquire.filing_mode: Physical Framed Display at Business Site
documents_to_fill_or_acquire.output_received: Form 2303 + 'Notice to the Public' (Ask for Receipt Sign)
